_readme: Edit this file, then run: python3 scripts/build_whoweare.py
It regenerates every HTML page in drafts/whoweare-redesign/.
'images' / 'videos' = how many empty placeholder slots that block gets.
'source' = the existing live page the material came from (shown as an
archive link; add "cta": true to render it as a button instead).
'note' = an amber flag on the page; 'todo' = a dashed box standing in
for copy that still has to be written.
'avatar' = a file in avatars/. Unassigned programmes use generic.png.
'status': 'past' moves a programme out of the main grid into the quiet 'Past programmes' list at the foot of its category page.
'page.mascots' = the avatars in the banner row. Four fits a phone; more will shrink them.
'page.proclamation' = the King County honour shown under the intro.

A category with 'leaf': true has no subcategory cards — it is one page with a description and a gallery. Community Service works that way: the service work is one continuous body, not a set of separate programmes.
'avatar_zoom' scales an avatar inside its clipped circle, for art that was uploaded with wide margins instead of cropped square.
'columns' fixes how many cards a category shows per row on desktop; it steps down to 2 then 1 on narrower screens.
'page.columns' sets the landing grid; it was 2 for four categories, 3 for five.
Copy below is the board's own wording from EmP_Website_All_Copy_Download.docx (2026-10-18). 'intro' is the landing card blurb; 'overview' is the text element on the category page.

page.title: Who We Are
page.intro: A grassroots parenting community since 2007, run entirely by volunteer families. Everything below is something our members organise themselves.
page.intro_zh: 自2007年起的民间父母社区，完全由义工家庭运营。以下每一项活动，都由会员自己组织。

proclamation.label: King County Proclamation
proclamation.text: King County proclaimed February 1, 2025 Emerald Parents Association Day.
proclamation.text_zh: 金县正式命名2025年2月1日为「Emerald Parents Association Day」。

categories.title: Learning & Enrichment
categories.intro: Learning opportunities for both parents and children through educational talks and study groups.
categories.intro_zh: 通过家长讲座和学习小组，为家长和孩子提供持续学习与成长的机会。

subcategories.title: Parent Education Talks
subcategories.summary: Topics covering parenting, education, and family life.
subcategories.summary_zh: 分享育儿、教育和家庭生活中的知识与经验。
subcategories.description: EmP regularly hosts educational talks on a wide range of topics, from parenting and education to family life and personal growth. Speakers include professionals and experienced parents who share their knowledge, perspectives, and real-life experiences.
subcategories.description_zh: EmP 定期举办各类家长讲座和经验分享会，围绕子女教育、成长与升学、家庭生活以及家长关心的其他话题，邀请专业人士和有经验的家长与大家分享知识与经验。

subcategories.title: Study Groups
subcategories.summary: Raz-Kids reading and the K–5 Math Challenge.
subcategories.summary_zh: Raz-Kids 阅读与 K–5 数学挑战。
subcategories.description: EmP offers study groups that encourage children with shared interests to participate in ongoing learning activities and build consistent learning habits. Our current programs include:Raz-Kids Reading Study Group: Encourages children to read regularly through the Raz-Kids leveled reading program, helping them build strong reading habits and improve their English reading skills over time.Math Challenge: Encourages children to engage with fun and challenging math problems on a regular basis, building their interest in math, mathematical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
subcategories.description_zh: EmP 组织学习小组，让感兴趣的孩子一起参与持续性的学习活动，在互相鼓励中培养良好的学习习惯。目前有两个项目：Raz-Kids Reading Study Group（英语阅读小组）：通过 Raz-Kids 分级阅读项目，鼓励孩子坚持阅读，在日积月累中提高英语阅读能力。Math Challenge（数学挑战）：通过定期参与 Math Challenge 趣味数学题，鼓励孩子保持对数学的兴趣，锻炼数学思维和解决问题的能力。

categories.overview: EmP creates opportunities for both parents and children to learn and grow. Through parent education talks and study groups, we encourage families to keep learning, share experiences, and grow together.
categories.overview_zh: EmP 为家长和孩子提供丰富的学习与成长机会。通过家长讲座和学习小组，我们鼓励家庭持续学习、分享经验、共同成长。

categories.title: Youth-Led Projects
categories.intro: Empowering youth to lead projects, build skills, and grow along the way.
categories.intro_zh: 鼓励青少年自主开展项目，在实践中锻炼能力、收获成长。

subcategories.title: EmP HackFest
subcategories.summary: A youth-led hackathon where students turn ideas into technology solutions.
subcategories.summary_zh: 青少年自主组织的编程比赛，用科技和创意解决实际问题。
subcategories.description: EmP HackFest is a youth-led hackathon where students work in teams to develop creative technology solutions to real-world challenges. Organized by student volunteers, the event brings together young people to explore coding, collaborate on projects, and develop problem-solving and teamwork skills.
subcategories.description_zh: EmP HackFest 是由青少年志愿者自主组织的黑客松编程比赛。参赛学生通过团队合作，运用编程和创新思维解决现实生活中的问题，在实践中锻炼解决问题、团队协作和沟通能力。
subcategories.source_label: Schedules, rules and registration on emphackfest.org

subcategories.title: Camps & Classes
subcategories.summary: Youth-led camps and classes covering a wide range of interests.
subcategories.summary_zh: 青少年志愿者组织和教授的各类兴趣课程与夏令营。
subcategories.description: EmP youth volunteers organize and lead a variety of camps and classes, sharing their knowledge and interests with participants. Past programs have covered Python programming, chemistry, soccer, minerals, and robotics, as well as summer camps organized in partnership with The Salvation Army.
subcategories.description_zh: EmP 青少年志愿者利用自己的知识和特长，组织和教授各类课程及夏令营。活动内容涵盖 Python 编程、化学、足球、矿物学、机器人等，也包括与救世军（The Salvation Army）合作举办的夏令营。

subcategories.title: Emerald Youth Review
subcategories.title_zh: 青少年文学与艺术创作
subcategories.summary: A youth-run platform showcasing writing and artwork by Asian-American youth.
subcategories.summary_zh: 由青少年主导，展示亚裔美国青少年的文学与艺术作品。
subcategories.description: Half literary review, half blog, Emerald Youth Review is a nonprofit platform dedicated to showcasing the writing and artwork of Asian-American youth in the greater Puget Sound area. It hosts two writing and art contests each year, with winning entries featured on the Emerald Youth Review website and cash prizes awarded to winners. The entire submission and judging process is led by youth volunteers.
subcategories.description_zh: Emerald Youth Review 是一个非营利博客，主要展示华盛顿州普吉特海湾地区亚裔美国青少年的写作和艺术作品。项目每年举办两次写作与艺术征稿比赛，获奖作品将在 Emerald Youth Review 网站上展出，获奖者还将获得不同金额的现金奖励。征稿和评审工作全部由青少年志愿者主导完成。

subcategories.title: Youth Dance, Vocal & Instrumental Clubs
subcategories.title_zh: 青少年舞蹈、声乐与乐器社团
subcategories.summary: Youth-led clubs for sharing a love of dance and music.
subcategories.summary_zh: 青少年自主组织的舞蹈与音乐社团，交流学习，分享兴趣。
subcategories.description: EmP's youth-led Dance, Vocal, and Instrumental Clubs bring together young people who share a passion for the performing arts. Led by youth volunteers, the clubs encourage members to share their skills, learn from one another, and explore their creative interests. The Dance Club has hosted summer workshops in K-pop, ballet, and jazz, and regularly shares dance tutorials so participants can practice at home and exchange tips with one another.
subcategories.description_zh: EmP 青少年舞蹈、声乐与乐器社团由青少年志愿者自主组织，让有共同兴趣的青少年互相交流、分享经验，一起享受音乐和舞蹈的乐趣。目前，舞蹈社团已举办 K-pop、芭蕾和爵士舞暑期工作坊，并定期推出舞蹈教学视频，方便大家在家练习、交流心得。
subcategories.source_label: Current schedule on EmP Weekly Activities

subcategories.title: Gavel Club
subcategories.summary: Rising Speakers — members ran the meetings themselves.
subcategories.summary_zh: Rising Speakers：会员自主主持每周例会。
subcategories.description: Rising Speakers Gavel Club met weekly for ages 10 to 17. Members chaired the meetings themselves, gave prepared and impromptu speeches, and evaluated one another. The club is no longer running.
subcategories.description_zh: Rising Speakers 演讲俱乐部曾每周聚会一次，面向10至17岁。会员自主主持会议，进行备稿与即兴演讲，并互相点评。该俱乐部现已停止活动。
subcategories.note: Which years did the club run? The site does not record a start or end date.

categories.overview: EmP encourages young people to turn their ideas and interests into meaningful projects. Through youth-led competitions, creative platforms, clubs, camps, and classes, students take the lead in planning, organizing, and running activities while developing leadership, teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills.
categories.overview_zh: EmP 鼓励青少年发挥自己的兴趣和特长，将想法付诸实践。通过自主策划和组织各类比赛、兴趣社团、夏令营和课程，以及开展文学与艺术创作活动，青少年在实践中锻炼领导力、团队协作、沟通和解决问题的能力。

categories.title: Community Service
categories.intro: Bringing families together to give back to the community through volunteer service.
categories.intro_zh: 鼓励家庭共同参与志愿服务，以实际行动回馈社区。

subcategories.title: Service Projects
subcategories.summary: Hands-on volunteer projects that give back to the community.
subcategories.summary_zh: 通过丰富多样的志愿服务项目，以实际行动回馈社区。
subcategories.description: EmP organizes a variety of hands-on community service projects, including tree planting and vegetation cleanup through Adopt-a-Park, making blankets for shelter cats, recycling used bicycles, preparing meals at Ronald McDonald House, and partnering with International Buddy to offer classes for children with autism.
subcategories.description_zh: EmP 组织开展丰富多样的社区公益项目，包括通过 Adopt-a-Park 项目参与公园植树和植物清理，为动物收容所制作猫毯，回收旧自行车，在麦当劳之家为入住家庭准备餐食，以及与 International Buddy 合作，为自闭症儿童提供课程等。

categories.overview: Community service has always been an important part of EmP. Through a variety of volunteer projects, we bring families together to give back to the community while encouraging young people to develop a sense of social responsibility and a lifelong commitment to helping others.
categories.overview_zh: 社区服务一直是 EmP 的重要组成部分。通过开展各类公益活动，我们鼓励家长和孩子共同参与志愿服务，回馈社区，同时帮助青少年培养社会责任感和服务他人的精神。

categories.title: Sports, Culture & Celebration
categories.intro: Bringing families together through sports, cultural celebrations, and social gatherings.
categories.intro_zh: 通过丰富多彩的体育、文化和联谊活动，丰富社区生活，增进彼此交流。

subcategories.title: Sports Meet
subcategories.summary: Track and field competitions and fun activities for the whole family.
subcategories.summary_zh: 田径比赛与亲子趣味活动，全家参与。
subcategories.description: As of 2026, EmP has held eight annual Sports Meets. Open to children and teens ages 3–18 as well as adults, the event features track and field competitions such as running, long jump, and throwing, along with fun activities for families. The Sports Meet brings the community together through fun athletic activities, friendly competition, and shared experiences.
subcategories.description_zh: 截至2026年，EmP 已成功举办八届社区运动会。3至18岁的青少年以及成人均可报名参加。运动会设有跑步、跳远、投掷等田径比赛，以及丰富多彩的亲子趣味活动，让大家在参与运动、享受比赛乐趣的同时，增进家庭与社区之间的交流和联系。

subcategories.title: Lunar New Year Celebration
subcategories.summary: Celebrating Lunar New Year through Chinese traditions and cultural activities.
subcategories.summary_zh: 欢庆春节，体验中华传统文化与浓浓年味。
subcategories.description: EmP celebrates Lunar New Year each year with a variety of cultural activities that bring Chinese traditions to life. Through cultural exhibitions, traditional arts and crafts, performances, and interactive activities, the celebration offers families an opportunity to experience Chinese culture, share traditions, and celebrate the holiday together.
subcategories.description_zh: EmP 每年举办春节庆祝活动，通过文化展览、传统手工艺展示、文艺表演和互动体验等丰富多彩的形式，传承和弘扬中华传统文化。春节活动也为家庭和社区成员提供了欢聚交流的机会，让大家共同感受浓浓的年味。

subcategories.title: Family Gatherings
subcategories.summary: Group camping trips and celebrations for graduating high school seniors.
subcategories.summary_zh: 集体露营、高中毕业生庆祝活动，共享家庭美好时光。
subcategories.description: EmP brings families together through shared traditions, including group camping trips and celebrations for graduating high school seniors. These gatherings give families opportunities to spend time together, celebrate important milestones, and create lasting memories as part of the EmP community.
subcategories.description_zh: EmP 通过集体露营、高中毕业生庆祝活动等，让会员家庭有机会相聚，共同分享生活中的美好时光。无论是一起走进大自然，还是庆祝孩子们人生中的重要时刻，这些活动都逐渐成为 EmP 大家庭珍贵的共同回忆。

subcategories.title: Kids’ Seasonal Fun
subcategories.summary: Halloween celebrations and Christmas crafts for kids and families.
subcategories.summary_zh: 万圣节庆祝与圣诞节手工活动，陪伴孩子快乐过节。
subcategories.description: EmP brings families together through fun seasonal activities for children, including Halloween celebrations and Christmas crafts. These events give kids opportunities to enjoy holiday traditions, take part in hands-on activities, and make happy memories with family and friends.
subcategories.description_zh: EmP 为孩子们组织丰富有趣的节日活动，包括万圣节庆祝活动和圣诞节手工制作。孩子们可以在欢乐的节日氛围中体验不同的节日传统，享受动手制作的乐趣，与家人和朋友共度美好时光。

subcategories.title: Parent Social Gatherings
subcategories.summary: Social gatherings for parents to connect, relax, and build friendships.
subcategories.summary_zh: 轻松愉快的家长聚会，交流生活，增进友谊。
subcategories.description: EmP organizes social gatherings that give parents opportunities to relax, connect, and build friendships. From Parents’ Out to activities for empty-nest families, these events bring parents together to share experiences, enjoy time with friends, and strengthen community connections.
subcategories.description_zh: EmP 组织各类家长联谊活动，为家长们提供放松身心、交流互动、结交朋友的机会。从家长聚会到空巢家庭活动，让处于不同人生阶段的家长有机会相聚交流、分享生活。

subcategories.title: Jingxing Cultural Discovery Program
subcategories.title_zh: 景行跨文化交流与学习
subcategories.summary: Exploring Chinese culture and fostering cross-cultural exchange through shared learning.
subcategories.summary_zh: 学习中华文化，促进跨文化交流，在共同探索中成长。
subcategories.description: The EmP Jingxing Program offers children opportunities to explore Chinese language and culture through creative learning and cultural exchange. The program helps children deepen their understanding of Chinese culture and encourages cross-cultural exchange. With guidance from the program’s lead teacher, older students mentor younger children as they learn and explore together.
subcategories.description_zh: EmP 景行项目以中文为主要交流和学习语言，通过丰富多样的文化体验和学习活动，帮助孩子们加深对中华文化的了解，促进跨文化交流。在项目负责老师的指导下，鼓励大孩子带领小孩子一起学习、交流和探索。

categories.overview: EmP brings families and community members together through a variety of sports, cultural, and social activities. From annual sports meets and holiday celebrations to family gatherings and cultural exchange programs, these events create opportunities to share traditions, build friendships, and strengthen community connections.
categories.overview_zh: EmP 通过丰富多彩的体育、文化和联谊活动，为家庭和社区成员增加了交流的机会。从一年一度的运动会、节日庆祝，到家庭聚会和文化交流项目，这些活动让大家分享文化传统、增进友谊，也让社区成员之间的联系更加紧密。

categories.title: Volunteer Appreciation
categories.intro: Celebrating volunteer contributions and recognizing their dedication to the community.
categories.intro_zh: 感谢志愿者的辛勤付出，表彰他们对社区的贡献。
categories.body:
Volunteers are at the heart of EmP. Their time, dedication, and generosity make our programs and events possible. Through volunteer appreciation gatherings, we celebrate their contributions and express our gratitude.

Young volunteers are recognized each year at our Youth Volunteer Appreciation event through two EmP awards. The EmPower Volunteer Service Award follows the standards of the national President's Volunteer Service Award, which EmP took part in for many years until that program ended. The EmP Spirit Award recognizes members aged 10 to 15 who complete at least 20 hours of EmP service during the year. Applicants apply for one award or the other.
categories.body_zh:
EmP 的各项活动和项目，离不开志愿者们的热情参与和辛勤付出。通过举办义工答谢活动，我们向志愿者表达感谢，肯定他们的贡献，也希望将这份志愿服务的热情和精神传承下去。

协会设有两项青少年义工奖项，每年在青少年义工答谢活动上颁发。EmPower Volunteer Service Award 沿用原总统义工服务奖（President's Volunteer Service Award）的标准——协会曾多年参与该评选，该项目现已结束。EmP Spirit Award 面向10至15岁的会员，需在年度周期内完成至少20小时的协会义工服务。两项奖项只能择一申请。
categories.note: Detail deliberately left off the page, from 'EmP Spirit Award FAQ' (Oct 2025): service year runs 9/1-8/31; applications to pvsa@emeraldparents.org between 9/1 and 9/15; committee reviews 9/16-9/30; awardees announced early October. Only EmP service hours count for ESA, fundraising events excluded, and hours from other organisations do not qualify. Age is judged by whichever age the volunteer held for at least seven months of the year. No written source yet for the EmPower award's own thresholds.
